# DK Mahal

> A centrally air-conditioned wedding venue for 500 seated guests, with 10 A/C rooms, a lift, valet parking and high-class vegetarian food.

Website: https://dkmandapam.com/
Phone / WhatsApp: 044 2620 2162

## Contact
- DK Mahal – Anna Nagar · W-114, 3rd Avenue, Anna Nagar, Chennai 600 040 · 044 2620 2162 · info@dkmandapam.com
- DK Mahal – Villivakkam · No. 198, Baba Nagar, Villivakkam, Chennai 600 049 · 044 2620 2162 · info@dkmandapam.com

## Key facts
- 500 guests seated
- 800 guests floating
- 150 in the dining hall at a time
- 10 fully air-conditioned rooms

## Facilities
- Centralised A/C
- Complete power backup
- Elevators for guests
- Valet parking
- CCTV surveillance
- Wi-Fi in rooms & hall
- LED displays
- Audio & video system
- 24-hour room service
- Lockers in every room
- Fire safety
- Vegetarian food

## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can DK Mahal hold?
The hall seats 500 guests and holds 800 floating; the dining hall seats 150 at a time.

### Where is DK Mahal?
W-114, 3rd Avenue, Anna Nagar, Chennai 600 040.

### What facilities does DK Mahal have?
Centralised A/C, Complete power backup, Elevators for guests, Valet parking, CCTV surveillance, Wi-Fi in rooms & hall, LED displays, Audio & video system, 24-hour room service, Lockers in every room, Fire safety, Vegetarian food.

### Is the food vegetarian?
Yes, we serve high-class vegetarian food.

### Do you have rooms?
Yes, 10 fully air-conditioned rooms with 24-hour room service and lockers.

### How do I book DK Mahal?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page, or call 044 2620 2162, or email info@dkmandapam.com.
